name: Can I live in my home during a remodel?

mainEntity.name: Can I live in my home during a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you can live in your home during a remodel depends on the extent and nature of the work. For minor projects, it may be feasible. However, for extensive renovations involving major structural changes, plumbing disruptions, or significant dust, it might be safer and more comfortable to arrange temporary accommodation. We will discuss this with you during planning.
acceptedAnswer.description: Living in your home during a remodel depends on the project's scope; major work may require temporary relocation.
